fields.description: Non-expiring System User access token with the ads_management permission, generated in Meta Business Settings.
fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: Meta Custom Audience (Customer List) ID. Find this in Ads Manager → Audiences → the audience's details.
fields.label: Audience ID

fields.description: Graph API version to call, e.g. v23.0.
fields.label: Graph API Version

fields.description: Country code prefixed to a phone number that doesn't already include one (e.g. a bare 10-digit Indian mobile number). Change this if leads start coming in from other countries.
fields.label: Default Phone Country Code

fields.description: ISO-2 lowercase country code sent to Meta for a Lead/Deal when no country value is available (CRM Lead/Deal have no country field today).
fields.label: Default Country
